youtube.title: The Doctor Who Put Food on a String
youtube.description:
1825. Army surgeon William Beaumont tied six foods to a silk string and lowered them into a living man's stomach, through an opening a gunshot had left. After one hour, the bread and cabbage were half gone. After two, four of the six had vanished. It was experiment #1 of 238.

The full story, from the accident to the last letter: "The Man With a Window Into His Stomach" (linked above).
